minister.name: Carlos Alvarado
minister.role: Minister of People's Power for Health

snapshot.text: A public system that provides most care, weakened by years of crisis: run-down hospitals, shortages of medicines and supplies, and the emigration of health workers. Since January 2026 an acting government under Delcy Rodríguez has promised oil revenue for health; earthquakes in mid-2026 added pressure.

priorities.title: Oil revenue for health
priorities.text: Acting President Rodríguez pledged that every dollar from oil and gas sales would go to the health system, and called on private companies to help raise capacity.

priorities.title: Private clinics for public patients
priorities.text: Patients waiting for surgery in public hospitals can request operations in private clinics through the VenApp platform; in June a commission was set up to contract works and services for the health sector.

priorities.title: Disasters and outbreaks
priorities.text: After the earthquakes hospitals were saturated and disease risk rose; in July the ministry responded to three hantavirus deaths.

netherlands.text: Venezuela borders the Kingdom through Aruba, Curaçao and Bonaire. After the June 2026 earthquakes the Netherlands sent its urban search and rescue team and HNLMS Groningen from Curaçao with relief supplies; Curaçao served as a regional hub.

timeline.text: Acting President Rodríguez pledges oil revenue for the health system.
Surgery in private clinics for public patients via VenApp.
Carlos Alvarado replaces Gutiérrez as health minister.
Commission created to contract works and services in the health sector.
PAHO award for Vice-Minister Noly Fernández for indigenous and intercultural health.
